description: Bundled assessment for international enterprise teams checking UK counterparties. Returns source-backed company evidence, uncertainty notes, verification questions, and jurisdiction context. Indicators only, not advice. Returns JSON with fields company_number, company_name, timestamp, caller_action, risk_bands, signals, priced_risk, evidence, audit_trail_id, regime_context, model_version, meta, source, liveUrl, recordDate, validUntil. Each answer states its record date and its source.

callerJurisdiction.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the caller home jurisdiction (for example US, DE, FR).

name: cross_border_assess
title: UK company cross-border evidence
